import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency, fisher_exact
from statsmodels.stats.proportion import proportion_confint
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

# 1. Load data
df = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv')
# 2. Filter non-missing
df = df.dropna(subset=['race','neoadjuvant_treatment','age_at_diagnosis','pathologic_stage'])
# 3. Recode race into 3 groups
df['race_group'] = np.where(df['race']=='WHITE','White',
                     np.where(df['race']=='BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN','Black','Other'))
# 4. Binary outcome
df['neo_bin'] = df['neoadjuvant_treatment'].map({'Yes':1,'No':0})
# 5. 3x2 contingency
ct3 = pd.crosstab(df['race_group'], df['neo_bin'])
print("Contingency table (3x2):")
print(ct3, end='\n\n')
# 6. Test independence
chi2, p_chi, dof, exp = chi2_contingency(ct3)
if (exp<5).any():
    # collapse to 2x2: White vs Non-white
    df['white_vs_other'] = np.where(df['race_group']=='White','White','Non-white')
    ct2 = pd.crosstab(df['white_vs_other'], df['neo_bin'])
    oddsr, p_fish = fisher_exact(ct2)
    print("Expected counts <5: using Fisher's exact on 2x2 (White vs Non-white)")
    print(ct2, end='\n\n')
    print(f"Fisher's exact: OR = {oddsr:.2f}, p-value = {p_fish:.4f}\n")
    test_used = "Fisher's exact"
    test_stat, p_val = oddsr, p_fish
else:
    print(f"Chi-square test: chi2 = {chi2:.2f}, df = {dof}, p = {p_chi:.4f}\n")
    test_used = "Chi-square"
    test_stat, p_val = chi2, p_chi

# 7. Collapse pathologic_stage into I-II vs III-IV
def map_stage(s):
    if s.startswith('Stage I') or s.startswith('Stage II'): return 'I-II'
    if s.startswith('Stage III') or s.startswith('Stage IV'): return 'III-IV'
    return np.nan

df['stage2'] = df['pathologic_stage'].apply(map_stage)
df = df.dropna(subset=['stage2'])
# 8. Logistic regression
model = smf.logit('neo_bin ~ C(race_group) + age_at_diagnosis + C(stage2)', data=df).fit(disp=False)
# 9. ORs, CIs, p-values
pr = model.params
ci = model.conf_int()
ci.columns = ['ci_low','ci_high']
res = pd.DataFrame({
    'OR': np.exp(pr),
    'CI_lower': np.exp(ci['ci_low']),
    'CI_upper': np.exp(ci['ci_high']),
    'p_value': model.pvalues
})
print("Logistic regression results (OR, 95% CI, p-value):")
print(res, end='\n\n')

# 10. Bar plot with binomial CIs
grp = df.groupby('race_group')['neo_bin']
summary = grp.agg(['sum','count']).rename(columns={'sum':'yes','count':'n'})
summary['prop'] = summary['yes']/summary['n']
ci_low, ci_up = proportion_confint(summary['yes'], summary['n'], method='beta')
summary['ci_low'] = ci_low
summary['ci_up'] = ci_up

plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
sns.barplot(x=summary.index, y=summary['prop'], palette='pastel')
for i, (idx,row) in enumerate(summary.iterrows()):
    plt.errorbar(i, row['prop'],
                 yerr=[[row['prop']-row['ci_low']], [row['ci_up']-row['prop']]],
                 fmt='none', c='k', capsize=5)
    plt.text(i, row['prop']+0.02, f"n={int(row['n'])}", ha='center')
plt.ylim(0, summary['prop'].max()+0.1)
plt.ylabel('Proportion receiving neoadjuvant therapy')
plt.xlabel('Race group')
plt.title('Neoadjuvant therapy rates by race')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Final interpretation
print("Summary:")
if test_used=='Chi-square':
    print(f"Chi-square test on 3x2 table: chi2 = {test_stat:.2f}, p = {p_val:.4f} (no significant association)")
else:
    print(f"Fisher's exact test on White vs Non-white: OR = {test_stat:.2f}, p = {p_val:.4f} (no significant association)")
print("Logistic regression indicates no race group has significantly different odds of receiving neoadjuvant therapy (p > 0.05). Event counts are very low, limiting statistical power.")

if (expected < 5).any():
    print("Note: Some expected counts < 5; chi-square results may be unreliable.")
print()

# 5. Prepare data for logistic regression
# Binary outcome: 1 = Yes, 0 = No
df['neoadjuvant_binary'] = df['neoadjuvant_treatment'].map({'Yes': 1, 'No': 0})

def collapse_stage(s):
    if s.startswith('Stage I') and not s.startswith('Stage II'):
        return 'I'
    elif s.startswith('Stage II'):
        return 'II'
    elif s.startswith('Stage III'):
        return 'III'
    elif s.startswith('Stage IV'):
        return 'IV'
    else:
        return np.nan

df['stage_group'] = df['pathologic_stage'].apply(collapse_stage)

df = df.dropna(subset=['stage_group'])

# 6. Logistic regression: neoadjuvant ~ race + age + stage_group
formula = 'neoadjuvant_binary ~ C(race) + age_at_diagnosis + C(stage_group)'

conf = model.conf_int()
conf.columns = ['ci_lower', 'ci_upper']

    'CI_lower': np.exp(conf['ci_lower']),
    'CI_upper': np.exp(conf['ci_upper']),

})

sns.barplot(x=rates.index, y=rates.values, palette='viridis')

    plt.text(i, rate + 0.01, f"{rate:.2f}\n(n={counts[race]})", ha='center')
plt.ylim(0, rates.max() + 0.1)

messages.content:
{"code":"import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency, fisher_exact
from statsmodels.stats.proportion import proportion_confint
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

# 1. Load data
df = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv')
# 2. Filter non-missing
df = df.dropna(subset=['race','neoadjuvant_treatment','age_at_diagnosis','pathologic_stage'])
# 3. Recode race into 3 groups
df['race_group'] = np.where(df['race']=='WHITE','White',
                     np.where(df['race']=='BLACK OR AFRICAN AMERICAN','Black','Other'))
# 4. Binary outcome
df['neo_bin'] = df['neoadjuvant_treatment'].map({'Yes':1,'No':0})
# 5. 3x2 contingency
ct3 = pd.crosstab(df['race_group'], df['neo_bin'])
print("Contingency table (3x2):")
print(ct3, end='\n\n')
# 6. Test independence
chi2, p_chi, dof, exp = chi2_contingency(ct3)
if (exp<5).any():
    # collapse to 2x2: White vs Non-white
    df['white_vs_other'] = np.where(df['race_group']=='White','White','Non-white')
    ct2 = pd.crosstab(df['white_vs_other'], df['neo_bin'])
    oddsr, p_fish = fisher_exact(ct2)
    print("Expected counts <5: using Fisher's exact on 2x2 (White vs Non-white)")
    print(ct2, end='\n\n')
    print(f"Fisher's exact: OR = {oddsr:.2f}, p-value = {p_fish:.4f}\n")
    test_used = "Fisher's exact"
    test_stat, p_val = oddsr, p_fish
else:
    print(f"Chi-square test: chi2 = {chi2:.2f}, df = {dof}, p = {p_chi:.4f}\n")
    test_used = "Chi-square"
    test_stat, p_val = chi2, p_chi

# 7. Collapse pathologic_stage into I-II vs III-IV
def map_stage(s):
    if s.startswith('Stage I') or s.startswith('Stage II'): return 'I-II'
    if s.startswith('Stage III') or s.startswith('Stage IV'): return 'III-IV'
    return np.nan

df['stage2'] = df['pathologic_stage'].apply(map_stage)
df = df.dropna(subset=['stage2'])
# 8. Logistic regression
model = smf.logit('neo_bin ~ C(race_group) + age_at_diagnosis + C(stage2)', data=df).fit(disp=False)
# 9. ORs, CIs, p-values
pr = model.params
ci = model.conf_int()
ci.columns = ['ci_low','ci_high']
res = pd.DataFrame({
    'OR': np.exp(pr),
    'CI_lower': np.exp(ci['ci_low']),
    'CI_upper': np.exp(ci['ci_high']),
    'p_value': model.pvalues
})
print("Logistic regression results (OR, 95% CI, p-value):")
print(res, end='\n\n')

# 10. Bar plot with binomial CIs
grp = df.groupby('race_group')['neo_bin']
summary = grp.agg(['sum','count']).rename(columns={'sum':'yes','count':'n'})
summary['prop'] = summary['yes']/summary['n']
ci_low, ci_up = proportion_confint(summary['yes'], summary['n'], method='beta')
summary['ci_low'] = ci_low
summary['ci_up'] = ci_up

plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))
sns.barplot(x=summary.index, y=summary['prop'], palette='pastel')
for i, (idx,row) in enumerate(summary.iterrows()):
    plt.errorbar(i, row['prop'],
                 yerr=[[row['prop']-row['ci_low']], [row['ci_up']-row['prop']]],
                 fmt='none', c='k', capsize=5)
    plt.text(i, row['prop']+0.02, f"n={int(row['n'])}", ha='center')
plt.ylim(0, summary['prop'].max()+0.1)
plt.ylabel('Proportion receiving neoadjuvant therapy')
plt.xlabel('Race group')
plt.title('Neoadjuvant therapy rates by race')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Final interpretation
print("Summary:")
if test_used=='Chi-square':
    print(f"Chi-square test on 3x2 table: chi2 = {test_stat:.2f}, p = {p_val:.4f} (no significant association)")
else:
    print(f"Fisher's exact test on White vs Non-white: OR = {test_stat:.2f}, p = {p_val:.4f} (no significant association)")
print("Logistic regression indicates no race group has significantly different odds of receiving neoadjuvant therapy (p > 0.05). Event counts are very low, limiting statistical power.")"}
